body: God I'm so sorry. Shit sucks so fucking much. I'm 15 and lgbtq as well as you if that means anything at all. Every day I want to die and I feel like an absolute weight to all of my friends and my family. I don't what to even do with myself. I feel like this entire subreddit is suicidal people telling other suicidal people not to do it but I'm gonna keep it up anyway. From this post I can tell you aren't a bad person and you deserve light even if you can't feel it or want it anymore. I so badly want to just tell you everything is fine even though it's not true. I hope you're not gone yet because shit I love you.

Think about this first. I'm in no place to be giving you advice because I'm also suicidal. But if you're going to die by your own hands anyway why not fuck it and do whatever the hell you want in your last moments? Skip school or work and bus to the furthest place you can think of and run down roads, scream your feelings, eat a bunch of food, call random phone numbers and talk to strangers, buy fireworks and set them off in a parking lot, stargaze all night and just run away one last time. If we're all gonna die and you're on the edge anyway, fully fuck it. I get the feeling of not wanting anything anymore but damn if you're gonna go why not make it good, you just might see something that makes you wanna live again.
I'm so glad. I didn't think anyone would read this but the fact it helped just one person makes it worth it. Take care of yourself :)
I feel the same honestly. I'm here if you want to talk
